name: topsolid_resolve_pdm_documents
description: Resolve up to 100 PDM objects to verified backing DocumentIds, keeping both ID kinds, names and document type. Projects/libraries may have metadata documents; do not assume they are modeling documents. Returns null where no document exists. No opening; use explicit minor revisions for historical work.

items.description: PdmObjectId, not DocumentId or type GUID.

name: topsolid_find_pdm_documents
description: Find document candidates by exact PDM name or universal (domain,name). Names can match multiple objects; preserve all candidates and ask for selection when ambiguous. Optional projectId scopes the query. Results include friendly names, owner, type and exact PDM IDs.

name.description: Exact PDM document name or universal name.

domain.description: With name, use universal-identifier lookup instead of display-name search.

projectId.description: Optional working/library project PdmObjectId. Omit to search all projects.

name: topsolid_list_pdm_document_revisions
description: List every major/minor revision relationship of one TopSolid PDM document, with revision text and exact historical DocumentId. IDs remain opaque; do not derive them by editing strings. Does not open or restore revisions.

pdmObjectId.description: TopSolid document PdmObjectId, not a revision ID.

name: topsolid_get_modeling_context
description: Resolve an EXISTING named working project and document to PDM and current DocumentId in ONE read, including type and whether already open. Prefer this over list_projects + search_documents + resolve_pdm_documents. Returns every duplicate (up to 64); never pick an ambiguous/incomplete result. Does not open/create/change anything. Use get_active_document only when the user means the active document.

documentName.description: Exact PDM document name within that project.

name: topsolid_update_pdm_objects
description: Update names/descriptions of up to 32 exact PDM objects after confirmation. Persistent PDM metadata changes, outside document modification/undo. Reads back each result; returns partial receipts on failure and never retries.

pdmObjectId.description: Exact PDM object selected from live results.

name.description: New PDM name. Names need not be unique.

name: topsolid_delete_pdm_documents
description: Delete up to 32 exact PDM document objects after confirmation. No folders/projects, revision purge or annihilation. This is PDM deletion, not deletion of elements inside a document. Outside document undo; partial outcomes are possible.

name: topsolid_restore_pdm_documents
description: Restore up to 32 deleted PDM document objects by their retained exact IDs after confirmation. This restores deleted objects, not an older document revision. Persistent action outside document undo.

items.description: Exact deleted document PdmObjectId from a prior receipt or live PDM query.

name: topsolid_check_in_pdm_objects
description: CHECK IN exact PDM objects using the native CheckInSeveral API. For an entire working project, pass its PdmObjectId with recursive=true. One confirmation includes all owned constituents, up to 128 targets; never traverses library references. Saving alone is NOT check-in. Reads back actual PDM states; partial/uncertain outcomes are never retried.

items.description: Exact working project, folder or document PdmObjectId.

recursive.description: Include owned descendants. Set true only for an explicitly requested whole project/folder check-in. Default false.

name: topsolid_save_documents
description: Save modified documents in ONE native batch and ONE confirmation. Default scope=openDirty selects modified OPEN documents, including synchronized partners. loadedDirty is available only for an explicit request to save all loaded documents, including dependencies. Alternatively supply exact documentIds. No preliminary document listing is needed. Maximum 128 affected documents; no check-in.

scope.description: Default openDirty. loadedDirty includes loaded dependency documents and must be explicitly requested.

items.description: Exact loaded document revision ID. Mutually exclusive with scope.

name: topsolid_find_named_elements

Scans native elements once, returns named, typed handles; never treats a type GUID as an element ID.

nameKind.description: Default friendlyName. Internal system names use their untranslated $... value.
